One character is predominantly green with dark outlines, appearing to leap or fall, while another figure in red/orange is partially visible behind them. The background is a mix of yellow and orange hues. Text elements are present but heavily degraded and illegible due to low resolution and compression artifacts. The style is consistent with mid-20th-century American comic books.
